“PROGRAM” SERVICES AGREEMENT
PRINCIPAL TERMS
EFFECTIVE DATE:[object Object]XXXX
PARTIES:Amazon Content Services LLC (“Amazon”)
PRODCO (“ProdCo”)
SERVICES:[object Object]ProdCo will render services as set forth in this agreement, including any exhibits and schedules attached hereto (which are incorporated by reference), which constitute the entire agreement between the parties (collectively, the “Agreement”), for the original scripted television series audio-visual program currently known as “PROGRAM” (together with all elements thereof, the “Program”).
RIGHTS: All rights in the Program, including all materials commissioned (including the results and proceeds of the services rendered hereunder) or previously created by or on behalf of ProdCo for the Program (the “Materials”) shall be owned by Amazon exclusively, throughout the universe, in perpetuity (or for the maximum legal term of protection, if shorter). The Materials constitute “works made for hire” / commissioned works for and by Amazon and, therefore, all rights therein will vest in Amazon, immediately upon creation. If and to the extent the foregoing does not operate to fully vest in Amazon all such rights, ProdCo hereby irrevocably grants, transfers and assigns to Amazon, exclusively, throughout the universe, in perpetuity (or for the maximum legal term of protection, if shorter), as and when they are created, all rights now known or hereafter devised (including under copyright, trademark, and performers’ rights) in and to the Materials and the Program (including all materials previously created for the Program) and all parts thereof, in all media and distribution modes whether currently known or hereafter devised. ProdCo hereby irrevocably waives (and will cause all individuals ProdCo engages for the Program to waive)[object Object]all so-called “moral rights” or “droit moral” and any similar or analogous rights to the maximum extent permitted under applicable law. To the extent that moral rights cannot be waived or assigned under applicable law, ProdCo irrevocably agrees (and will cause all individuals ProdCo engages for the Program to agree) not to exercise any right or institute any action with respect to such moral rights that would hinder, burden or stop the use and commercial exploitation of the Materials and/or the Program, including any preliminary action or measure for the same purpose.

FEES:[object Object]If ProdCo is not in demonstrated breach of this Agreement, subject to any other applicable terms and conditions, ProdCo will receive the fees specified in Exhibit A.

ENTITLEMENTS; CREDIT:[object Object]If ProdCo is not in material[object Object]breach of this Agreement, and completes ProdCo’s services hereunder, subject to any other applicable terms and conditions (including any applicable guild/union requirements), ProdCo will receive the entitlements and credit specified in Exhibit A for the applicable episode(s). Except as otherwise specified herein, all aspects of credits will be at Amazon’s sole discretion. Amazon’s inadvertent failure to comply with such credit obligations will not constitute a breach of this Agreement, but upon receipt of written notice from ProdCo, Amazon will make commercially reasonable efforts to correct any credit error by Amazon on a prospective basis.[object Object]Amazon shall use reasonable efforts to inform all third parties with whom Amazon is in contractual privity of the credit obligations set forth herein,[object Object]but is not responsible or liable to ProdCo for any failure of any third parties to comply with such credit obligations.[object Object]

Each of Amazon and ProdCo represents, warrants and agrees that such party has measures in place designed to ensure compliance with applicable laws, rules and regulations (including import/re-import, sanctions, anti-boycott, export/re-export control laws and tax evasion and tax evasion facilitation laws). ProdCo will indemnify, defend (at Amazon’s option), and hold harmless Amazon and its assignees, licensees, and each of their affiliates against any losses, liability, damages, judgements, cost or expenses (“Losses”) arising out of any third-party claim in connection with[object Object]the development and production by ProdCo of the Program,[object Object]ProdCo’s breach[object Object]of any of its agreements, representations or warranties under this Agreement and/or ProdCo’s negligence or willful misconduct. Amazon will indemnify, defend, and hold harmless ProdCo and its affiliates, and successors against any Losses arising out of any third-party claim in connection with the distribution[object Object]marketing and exploitation of the Program and all ancillary rights therein and thereto[object Object]by Amazon or its affiliates, other than with respect to any Losses for which ProdCo is required to indemnify Amazon under this Agreement.[object Object]If either Amazon or Prodco is entitled to defense or indemnification hereunder, the indemnitee will give the indemnifying party prompt written notice of the applicable claim (but any delay in notification will not relieve the indemnifying party of its indemnification obligations under this Agreement except to the extent that such delay materially impairs the indemnifying party’s ability to defend such claim). Amazon will have the option to control the defense and settlement of any claim. In addition, ProdCo will have the right to participate, at its own expense and with counsel of its own choosing, in the defense of any claim.

MISCELLANEOUS (CONDITIONS PRECEDENT, DAMAGES, INJUNCTIVE RELIEF, ASSIGNMENT, ETC.): Amazon’s obligations hereunder are subject to any conditions precedent set forth in Exhibit A. As between ProdCo and Amazon, Amazon has sole and final control over the Program.[object Object]ProdCo will not release or authorize any publicity or marketing relating to the Program or use any Amazon trademark without Amazon’s prior written approval, and ProdCo will keep confidential all non-public information relating to the Program (“NPI”) [GIVE: and refrain from revealing such NPI to any entity or individual, except: [POSSIBLE GIVE: (a) as required to fulfill its obligations hereunder,][object Object][POSSIBLE GIVE: (b) to its affiliates, employees, contractors, agents or professional service providers (i.e., accountants, lawyers, and/or financial advisors) with a need to know such information, who are bound to maintain the confidentiality of such information under terms substantially similar to those of this Agreement,][object Object][POSSIBLE GIVE: (c) as expressly permitted in writing by Amazon,] or [POSSIBLE GIVE: (d) as required by law or the valid order of a court of competent jurisdiction, in which event ProdCo will so notify Amazon and will seek confidential treatment of such information]][object Object]and ProdCo has not and will not input or permit others to input any NPI, the Program, or the Materials into any artificial intelligence service or tool unless and to the extent compliant with Amazon policy. [GIVE (WITH AMAZON LEGAL APPROVAL) (see Foote 20): Amazon will make reasonable efforts to notify ProdCo of an assignment by Amazon of this Agreement in whole (for clarity, Amazon will not need to make such efforts to notify ProdCo for a partial assignment of this Agreement including with respect to Amazon’s assignment of its rights) unless such assignment is to an Amazon affiliate, provided that inadvertent failure to do so will not be deemed a breach of this Agreement nor affect the validity of such assignment.][object Object][ALTERNATE GIVE (WITH AMAZON LEGAL REGIONAL LEAD (e.g., Hendrik for International) APPROVAL): REMOVE previous sentence and REPLACE with: On a non-precedential, non-citable basis, Amazon may not assign this Agreement without ProdCo’s prior written consent; provided, however, that Amazon may assign (i) this Agreement to an entity affiliated with, owned or controlled by, or owning or controlling Amazon, or an entity that succeeds to substantially all of the assets of Amazon, and (ii) any of Amazon’s rights hereunder to any third parties. ProdCo hereby agrees any assignment by Amazon consented to by ProdCo (or otherwise meeting the conditions of the foregoing sentence) will be binding upon and inure to the benefit of ProdCo and assignee.][object Object]ProdCo will execute and deliver all additional documents and do any other acts [GIVE:[object Object]consistent herewith][object Object]as Amazon [GIVE: reasonably] requests in order to establish or evidence Amazon’s rights hereunder, including, registration and assignment of the Materials. If ProdCo fails to do so within 5 [POSSIBLE GIVE 1: replace “5” with “7”][object Object][POSSIBLE GIVE 2: replace “5” with “10”] business days following Amazon’s request [GIVE: (during which period ProdCo may review and comment on such document)], ProdCo hereby irrevocably authorizes Amazon to act on ProdCo’s behalf, including by providing Amazon with a [GIVE: limited][object Object]power of attorney (coupled with an interest) solely to execute, register and record such documents on ProdCo’s behalf.[object Object][GIVE: Amazon will provide ProdCo with copies of such documents so executed promptly thereafter, provided that inadvertent failure to do so will not be deemed a breach of this Agreement and any failure to do so will not affect the validity of such documents.] Amazon may elect to suspend any services, and any option exercise and/or other applicable dates under this Agreement will automatically extend, for a period of up to the length of (i) any unavailability, disability or death of any key personnel or cast, or any “force majeure” event (earthquake or other natural event, government action, labor dispute, acts of war or terrorism, epidemic, pandemic, or any other event beyond the control of Amazon), which interrupts or interferes with the Program; and/or (ii) any claims or litigation relating to the Program and/or ProdCo’s breach, plus 30 [GIVE: replace “30” with “15”] days following cessation of any of the foregoing events in clause (i) and/or (ii) as applicable [GIVE:, provided that the period of any such suspension and/or extension will not exceed 6 months in the aggregate with respect to any single force majeure event (excluding labor disputes)][object Object][GIVE:, provided that the period of any such suspension and/or extension will not exceed [POSSIBLE GIVE 1: 12][object Object][POSSIBLE GIVE 2 (WITH AMAZON LEGAL APPROVAL): 6] months in the aggregate with respect to any single claim (other than a claim resulting from ProdCo’s breach hereunder) unless litigation has been filed or arbitration/mediation proceedings have been initiated][object Object][ALTERNATIVE GIVE (IF PROVIDING CAP FOR BOTH FORCE MAJEURE AND CLAIMS/LITIGATION):,[object Object]provided that the period of any such suspension and/or extension will not exceed (a) 6 months in the aggregate with respect to any single force majeure event (excluding labor disputes) and (b) [POSSIBLE GIVE 1: 12][object Object][POSSIBLE GIVE 2 (WITH AMAZON LEGAL APPROVAL): 6] months in the aggregate with respect to any single claim (other than a claim resulting from ProdCo’s breach hereunder) unless litigation has been filed or arbitration/mediation proceedings have been initiated]. [GIVE: Amazon shall confirm the suspension in writing, provided that no inadvertent failure by Amazon to deliver notice of suspension will be deemed a breach of this Agreement or in any way affect the effectiveness of such suspension.][object Object]ProdCo has or will obtain signed agreements from each principal, employee or other individual prior to rendering services in connection with the Program on terms consistent with this Agreement (including rights and assignment terms hereof) and in a form approved by Amazon. Any production order of the Program will not be effective unless in written notice signed by Amazon. This Agreement includes and incorporates industry custom standard terms and conditions for agreements of this type, such as insurance and additional representations/warranties, indemnification and remedies. At Amazon’s request [GIVE: or, if earlier, after Amazon’s exercise of its option to order production of the initial season of the Program], these additional terms will be formalized as part of this Agreement subject to good faith negotiation within [GIVE: REMOVE:[object Object]Amazon’s customary parameters AND REPLACE WITH: customary industry parameters for agreements of this type]; provided that unless and until such time, industry custom standard terms and conditions will prevail.

DATA PROTECTION:[object Object]When processing personal data in connection with this Agreement, Amazon or ProdCo shall act as independent data controllers and shall be individually and separately responsible for their own compliance with applicable data protection legislation, including, where applicable, the European General Data Protection Regulation and any implementing or equivalent national laws. Where applicable, ProdCo agrees to provide Amazon’s privacy notice (as amended from time to time) to, and if relevant, seek the consent of any data subject whose personal data is processed by Amazon for the purpose of the Agreement.

TAX; GOVERNING LAW; JURISDICTION: Each party will be responsible for identifying and paying all taxes and other governmental fees and charges that are legally imposed on that party upon or with respect to the transactions and payments under this Agreement. All amounts to be paid by Amazon are [GIVE (WITH AMAZON TAX, FINANCE, AND BA APPROVAL ON A CASE-BY-CASE BASIS: DELETE:[object Object]inclusive[object Object]AND REPLACE WITH: exclusive][object Object]of all transaction taxes that ProdCo may be legally obligated to charge to Amazon on a valid tax invoice.[object Object][ALTERNATE GIVE (WITH AMAZON TAX, FINANCE, AND LEGAL REGIONAL LEAD (e.g., Hendrik for International) APPROVAL ON A CASE-BY-CASE BASIS (see Footnote 41):[object Object]On a season-by-season basis, upon request of ProdCo, Amazon will inform ProdCo in writing, before the first payment installment is due, of any change in Amazon’s status for the purposes of [INSERT: applicable tax] (or confirm that there has been no such change), and will confirm there will be no changes to such status prior to payment of the final payment installment in respect of that season.][object Object]Amazon may deduct or withhold any taxes that Amazon may be legally obligated to deduct or withhold from any amounts payable to ProdCo under this Agreement, and payment to ProdCo as reduced by such deductions or withholdings will constitute full payment and settlement to ProdCo of accounts payable under this Agreement. Throughout the term of this Agreement, ProdCo will provide Amazon with any forms, documents, or certifications as may be required for Amazon to satisfy any tax information reporting or withholding tax obligations with respect to any payments under this Agreement.[object Object][GIVE (WITH AMAZON TAX AND FINANCE APPROVAL): If a payment to ProdCo is reduced by such a deduction or withholding, Amazon will provide ProdCo with documentation supporting the amount of such deduction or withholding as legally obligated, which shall be satisfied by providing IRS Form 1042-S or a similar form issued by a tax authority.][object Object][GIVE: DELETE:[object Object]THIS AGREEMENT WILL BE CONSTRUED AND ENFORCED IN ACCORDANCE WITH THE LAW OF THE STATE OF CALIFORNIA APPLICABLE THEREIN, REGARDLESS OF WHERE NEGOTIATION, EXECUTION OR PERFORMANCE OF THIS AGREEMENT MAY ACTUALLY OCCUR. ANY DISPUTE RELATING TO THIS AGREEMENT OR THE PROGRAM WILL BE SUBJECT TO CONFIDENTIAL, BINDING ARBITRATION PURSUANT TO AND ADMINISTERED BY JAMS IN ACCORDANCE WITH ITS U.S. RULES AND THE U.S. FEDERAL ARBITRATION ACT/CALIFORNIA LAW, WITHOUT REGARD TO CONFLICT OF LAWS, AND CONDUCTED IN ENGLISH IN LOS ANGELES COUNTY, WITH EACH PARTY RESPONSIBLE FOR ITS OWN ATTORNEY’S FEES AND COSTS. clauses.heading: DATA PROTECTION:[object Object]When processing personal data in connection with this Agreement, Amazon or ProdCo shall act as independent data controllers and shall be individually and separately responsible for their own compliance with applicable data protection legislation, including, where applicable, the European General Data Protection Regulation and any implementing or equivalent national laws. Where applicable, ProdCo agrees to provide Amazon’s privacy notice (as amended from time to time) to, and if relevant, seek the consent of any data subject whose personal data is processed by Amazon for the purpose of the Agreement.
